notes.title: Patch 1.8
notes.notes:
Hopefully the last ever patch I have to upload.
Here's some stuff that was changed:
- Fixed the key in the bar scene clipping through the floor.
- Fixed Choppie not being able to capture you when sensed in the bar scene.
- Kinda remastered the settings menu.
- Controller support fixed. 
- Slight changes to the main menu.

notes.title: Choppie's 1.6 Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello hello! We're back with TONS of changes and bug fixes for this game. And lots of added content as well :)
The list of added stuff/changes/fixes would be huge and long to write, and I forgot what I even fixed, so here are all the big changes:
-The Main Menu has been completely changed!
-You can now select which chapter of the game to play in the main menu.
-Settings Menu completely remade!
-The Level 1 Map is completely remade! (Well, most of the map)
-Outside Level Completely changed!
-Renamed the team name and changed the team logo.
-Made it so that you can skip the splash screen.
-Added DLSS, FSR, and TAA to the game.
-The settings menu now actually saves.
-Made it so that you can die when you fall from the staircase. (Will give you an achievement for that.)
-Save System is fully fixed!
-Optimization.
-Tons of bug fixes.
-Changed Trees Model
-Changed the graphics a bit better.
I think that's it, folks! That's all that I can remember.
You can still play the old version by going to the game's properties in your library -> Betas -> Beta Participation -> old version
Chapter 2 is coming soon! We're not giving up, see you on the flip side :D

-Banshimo Team

notes.title: Version 1.5 Update
notes.notes:
This may be the final version because there's nothing else to do in the project. 
Fixed/Added:
-Saving system that makes you skip from the start to the hallway.
-Fixed Jumpscare animation when Choppie snaps your neck.
-Added additional ambience in the ventilation system
-Added an option to delete your save data in the main menu.
-A tiny bit of optimization.
-Choppie's AI sense fix.

See you all in chapter 2! And maybe in some other games that we make.

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Added:
-Ability to exit the phone using the back button instead of pressing "I" again.
-Remade Choppie's first encounter animation.
-Chase music.
-A rat in the ventilation.

Fixed:
-Saving system. (I'm sorry to the ones who suffered.)
-When Choppie busts down the door for the first time, the door starts to float. 
-Rain sounds don't work after going back upstairs.
-Computer startup is very slow or doesn't work if you go to it a second time.
-High FOV makes the phone very janky to use.
-Dynamic resolution scale is called "Field of view" in the graphics settings.
-Choppie being blind as shit in the first encounter.
-You can no longer move when the jumpscare animation starts, displacing you somewhere out of Choppie's reach.
-Terrain disappearing in the intro if you do so much as breathe wrong.
-You can no longer skip the first encounter by running to the door.
-The flash drive floating away when you look at it in a certain direction.
-Fixed the hallucination of just standing still, doing nothing.

Find any other bugs? Please kindly report them on our discord server! https://discord.gg/z5z8fjJdR5

notes.title: Game Engine Switch
notes.notes:
Hey guys! It has been a reaally long time since we updated you with any changes, this is the first update that is gonna be written so yeah. After seeing the new Unity guidelines we decided to switch to Unreal Engine 5, even though Unity declined their payment fee guideline thingy, we still won't come back to that game engine. Anyways, Choppie is close to release, stay tuned!
Later gators.
